pages.title: Crops
pages.text: This mod adds new crops that grow on $(thing)farmland$() just like vanilla ones:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Black Pepper$(): the seed is a Black Pepper Corn$(li)$(thing)Chili Pepper$(): the seed is Chili Seeds$(li)$(thing)Garlic$(): the seed is Garlic$(li)$(thing)Soybean$(): the seed is Soybean

pages.title: Harvest by Right-Clicking
pages.text: Once ripe you can $(thing)right-click$() to harvest: no tool needed, no durability lost, and Fortune has no effect.$(br2)Except for black pepper, the other three reset to their first stage and have to grow again.

pages.title: Breaking Gives More
pages.text: Breaking a ripe crop $(thing)whole$() with a tool or a bare hand drops more than right-clicking, and it $(thing)benefits from Fortune$().$(br2)Break the whole plant if you want seeds or a big haul, and right-click to keep harvesting.

pages.title: What They Are For
pages.text: $(li)Black pepper corns are ground into black pepper powder with a $(l:moderndelight:kitchenwares/utils)Stone Mortar$(), then bottled into a shaker$(li)Chilies can be eaten, made into a chili powder shaker, or simmered into $(thing)Chili Sauce$() in an oven$(li)Garlic can be sliced into cloves with a knife, or made into garlic powder$(li)Soybeans can be turned into soy milk, tofu and more
